description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract test class for the AnySoftKeyboard project, providing setup and utility methods for testing keyboard input methods using Robolectric and Mockito.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardBaseTest
classes.description: An abstract test class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for testing the AnySoftKeyboard input method service.

methods.name: getCurrentTestInputConnection
methods.description: Returns the current test input connection from the keyboard under test.

methods.name: getMockCandidateView
methods.description: Returns the mock candidate view associated with the keyboard under test.

methods.name: getServiceClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the service being tested.

methods.name: setUpForAnySoftKeyboardBase
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating the keyboard service, setting up input sessions, and simulating initial conditions.

methods.name: getShadowInputMethodManager
methods.description: Returns the shadow object for the InputMethodManager.

methods.name: createEditorInfoTextWithSuggestionsForSetUp
methods.description: Creates an EditorInfo object with suggestions for setup.

methods.name: verifyNoSuggestionsInteractions
methods.description: Verifies that no suggestions interactions have occurred.

methods.name: verifySuggestions
methods.description: Verifies that the suggestions match expected values.

methods.name: verifyAndCaptureSuggestion
methods.description: Captures and returns the list of suggestions set on the candidate view.

methods.name: simulateOnStartInputFlow
methods.description: Simulates starting the input flow with optional restart.

methods.name: getResText
methods.description: Retrieves a text resource by its ID.
